newsitem.title: USA: Basin Electric 550 MW Wyo. coal unit seen back Fri.
newsitem.headline: Basin Electric 550 MW Wyo. coal unit seen back Fri.

text.p: Basin Electric Cooperative said it expects the 550 megawatt (MW) Laramie River Station (LRS) coal-fired power unit 3 to resume service late Friday following a shutdown for a boiler tube leak.
The unit, in Wheatland, Wyo., was shut Tuesday to repair the leak.
"We expect it to be back in service sometime late Friday," a Basin spokesman said Thursday.
The plant's other two 550 MW units were operating normally.
Basin Electric, headquartered in Bismark, N.D., is the operator of the LRS plant and holds about a 42 percent interest in the plant.
Five other Midwest public utilities co-own the plant.
